With legacy semantics and the default `"auto"` (or explicit `"multiindex"`), `_as_model_snapshots` returns its input unchanged. If `create_model` builds over a subset of network snapshots, `solve_model` still supplies all of `n.snapshots` through `_call_extra_functionality`, rather than the model’s stored snapshot subset. Thus the callback can receive snapshots beyond those the model was built over.
